summary: Feed c062_span is severely degraded by SPAN oversubscription: 35.3% packet loss (1.55 Gbps mirrored from DC-CORE-1 Gi1/0/1 into 1 Gbps SPAN destination Gi1/0/48). NDR receives incomplete traffic and detection coverage is compromised. Physical link shows no errors.

findings.root_cause: SPAN destination oversubscription on DC-CORE-1: Gi1/0/1 mirror generates 11,595,000 packets / 1.55 Gbps but SPAN destination Gi1/0/48 is only 1 Gbps. Switch discards 4,095,000 packets on egress (average load 100% of 1 Gbps, bursts higher) = 35.32% loss. SPAN has no buffering/lossless guarantee and drops under load.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses ~35% of packets and flows. Bidirectional flow reassembly, signature matching, and anomaly detection fail randomly; attacks and lateral movement are missed, forensics are incomplete, and NDR efficacy is severely reduced despite its 10 Gbps capacity.

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, line-rate copy independent of switch buffers/CPU and preserves both directions. Connect TAP to packet broker at 10G to match NDR's 10G port and eliminate the 1G SPAN bottleneck, restoring complete traffic for detection.
